statements.status_notes: Zipkin Lens 3.6.1 initializes i18next with four static translation bundles compiled into its JavaScript. Its application never calls addResourceBundle; the only bundled library call supplies three arguments, leaving deep and overwrite unset. The vulnerable deepExtend path therefore cannot execute for translations in this image. GHSA-6jcc-5g8w-32mx requires attacker-controlled resources passed to addResourceBundle with both deep=true and overwrite=true. See https://github.com/i18next/i18next/security/advisories/GHSA-6jcc-5g8w-32mx and https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/blob/3.6.1/zipkin-lens/src/translations/i18n.ts
